bindings.source: A little read-aloud book for one decade of the Rosary: The Resurrection.

This book walks children through the First Glorious Mystery, the Resurrection: a short story, the Gospel passage, the Our Father, ten Hail Marys and the Glory Be, and a reflection on faith and new life.
Toggle reader mode for easier reading
Automatically read next page when current page finishes
Please wait while we open the storybook.
Read aloud in the browser with your device voice; studio narration is not available yet. The painting is a public-domain work credited below.
Painting: Carl Heinrich Bloch, The Resurrection. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

The Gospel passage is quoted word for word from the Douay-Rheims Bible, 1899 American Edition, which is in the public domain; verse numbers are omitted for reading aloud, and … marks skipped verses. The Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be and Fatima prayers follow the standard formulas used across this site. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Wednesday / Sunday.
What is the First Glorious Mystery?

The Resurrection. Very early on the first day of the week, the women found the stone rolled away and the tomb empty. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Wednesday / Sunday, and its fruit is faith and new life.
How do you pray this decade with children?
Read one page at a time. On the decade page, pray the Our Father once, the Hail Mary ten times (one for each bead), then the Glory Be and the Fatima prayer.
A Rosary decade book for children. Author: Please pray for the person who made this website.
